working: Conjugated double bonds alternate with a single bond, so they sit at positions n and n+2. In hepta-1,3-diene the bonds are C1=C2 and C3=C4, separated by one single bond (C2–C3), so they are conjugated. The 1,4-, 1,5- and 1,6-dienes have one or more sp3 carbons between the double bonds, so they are isolated.
